notes.text:
This update for redis7 fixes the following issue:

- CVE-2026-81934: TLS pending-data handling can cause use-after-free (bsc#1277794).

notes.text: Redis contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the 'tlsProcessPendingData()' function, which handles the TLS pending-data list if Redis is configured with TLS support. A remote, unauthenticated attacker may be able to execute arbitrary commands with the privileges of the Redis server.
